title: Re-analysis and automatic markup keep your warp markers and snap to your grid
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Re-analysis and automatic markup keep your warp markers and use your grid

  Scenario: Re-analysis keeps them
    Given the analyzed sample "steady-120.wav" with my warp markers
    When I re-analyze it with --force
    Then my warp markers are unchanged

  Scenario: Automatic markup keeps them
    Given the analyzed sample "steady-120.wav" with my warp markers
    When I re-run automatic markup on it
    Then my warp markers are unchanged
    And no marker of the machine's is named "warp"

  Scenario: Automatic markup snaps to your bar lines
    Given my warp markers on "steady-120.wav" move bar 3's downbeat 100 ms later than the analysis
    When I re-run automatic markup on it
    Then every machine loop and section that starts at bar 3 starts at my bar 3's downbeat

  Scenario: Sidecar export writes your grid
    Given my warp markers on "steady-120.wav"
    When I export its sidecars
    Then the sidecar's warp markers are mine
```
